title: The Standing Stone
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The standing stone in the village meadow has cast the same shadow at noon for eight hundred years. When the shadow begins to drift — a finger\'s width a day, then a hand\'s — the village sends its youngest herder, Alba, to the stone. The stone has a name it has not spoken in eight hundred years, and it is waiting for someone who will ask it properly.
